decision.title: Namespace node tests with a name (P4)
decision.summary: A namespace node test accepts a name: namespace::x resolves like an unprefixed attribute name and matches the namespace node whose prefix is x; a prefixed name matches nothing.

body.p: by packet , on the orchestrator's acceptance of P4 (design edit to the comment of sxml_node_test in include/sxml/types.h). The registry's normal form accepts any name test for SXML_NODE_KIND_NAMESPACE (no type, no document element); lowering resolves namespace::x like an attribute name (no namespace), so it matches the namespace node whose prefix is x; a prefixed name matches nothing. The node-test matcher compares the namespace node's name, which the tree interns as the prefix in no namespace ().
